ideas.children_he: מִזְבַּח הַקְּטוֹרֶת וְהַקְטָרְתָהּ — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Instructions for building the gold-covered incense altar, placing it before the curtain, and burning incense morning and evening. Unauthorized offerings are forbidden, and annual atonement is performed with sacrificial blood. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: מַחֲצִית הַשֶּׁקֶל לִמְפַקֵּד יִשְׂרָאֵל — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Every Israelite aged twenty and older gives a half-shekel during the census. The rich give no more and the poor no less; the money supports the Tent of Meeting and serves as remembrance and atonement. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: כִּיּוֹר הַנְּחוֹשֶׁת וּרְחִיצַת הַכּוֹהֲנִים — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: A bronze basin filled with water is placed between the Tent of Meeting and the altar. Aaron and his sons wash their hands and feet before entering or serving, as an eternal ordinance. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: הֲכָנַת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׂחָה — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Moses is instructed to prepare holy anointing oil from selected spices and olive oil, blended by a skilled perfumer. The mixture is to become sacred anointing oil. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: מַשִׁיחַת כְּלֵי הַמִּשְׁכָּן — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: The anointing oil is applied to the Tabernacle, Ark, table, lampstand, incense altar, burnt-offering altar, basin, and their utensils. Through anointing they become most holy. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: מִשִׁיחַת אַהֲרֹן וּבִנָיוּ לִכְהוּנָּה — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: Aaron and his sons are anointed and consecrated to serve as priests before the Lord. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׂחָה קוֹדֶשׁ לְדוֹרוֹת — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: The anointing oil belongs to God forever and may not be used ordinarily or reproduced for personal use. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: הֲכָנַת הַקְּטוֹרֶת הַקְּדוֹשָׁה — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: God instructs Moses to combine spices and pure frankincense into a blended, salted, pure, and holy incense. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: הַקְּטוֹרֶת לִפְנֵי הָעֵדוֹת — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: The incense is finely ground and placed before the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where God meets Moses. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.

ideas.children_he: אִיסּוּר שִׁימּוּשׁ פְּרָטִי בִּקְטוֹרַת — כָּל פְּרָט בַּמְּלָאכָה חָשׁוּב. כְּשֶׁעוֹבְדִים בְּסַבְלָנוּת וּבִשְׁתּוּף פְּעֻלָּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִבְנוֹת דָּבָר גָּדוֹל וּמְיֻחָד.
ideas.children_en: The incense may not be reproduced for personal use or ordinary enjoyment; it is holy to God, and violators are cut off from their people. Careful work, patience, and cooperation help people create something special.
